head.purpose: Sheet heads, stamps, nav, and button labels in condensed caps.

mono.purpose: Codes, values, voltages, and editable numbers with tabular figures.

dos: Do mark touched things with highlighter and run things with stamps — marks over chrome, always.
Do set every value, ID, voltage, and current in Courier Prime with tabular numerals.
Do keep sheets on the board ground with the pinned-sheet shadow; the app background is never white.
Do give every empty, loading, error, stale, locked, and read-only state its own stamped or ruled message.
donts: Don't use the dark-IDE palette, grey-plus-blue SaaS accents, or rounded card grids.
Don't add a UI framework, icon system, or hosted font; faces are self-hosted woff2 beside the app.
Don't use color alone for state; every wash and stamp pairs with text.
Don't let a paper effect (tape, rotation, texture) cost legibility or speed; flat paper wins ties.
keyCharacteristics: Sheets and strips, never cards and heroes: every surface is a pinned sheet with a ruled head.
Marks over chrome: selection is a highlighter wash, outcomes are stamps.
Density with intent: packed modules and small mono values, each with a ruled header.
Ink on paper, everywhere: toner text, biro action color, red for void, green for pass.
narrative.overview: The interface is a departmental worktable: kraft board under everything, copy-paper sheets pinned on top for each panel, toner text, biro links, highlighter for whatever the user touched, and rubber stamps for whatever ran. Exact and unhurried: plain, exact, and fast copy; nothing cute, nothing that slows a lab session; it reads as physical working material, not software chrome. The system deliberately refuses the category defaults — no dark IDE chrome, no grey-plus-blue SaaS softness, no gamified states, no rounded card grids.

rules.body: Color has exactly three jobs: highlighter marks what the user touched; stamp red voids what failed; stamp green passes what succeeded; biro is the only action blue. Nothing else gets a color.
rules.name: The Three-Jobs Rule

rules.body: A highlight wash or stamp always pairs with a text label or value; color is never the only carrier of state.
rules.name: The Marked-Surface Rule

rules.body: Rank is carried by case, weight, and rules — never by a new size alone.
rules.name: The Case-Carries-Rank Rule

rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; the single shadow vocabulary exists only to separate a sheet from the board.
rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
